answer.headline: Conversion rate dropped beyond normal variation due to a product break on the home landing page.
explanation: Overall conversion rate fell significantly compared to previous weeks.
Sessions landing on the Home page experienced a severe drop in product views and conversion compared to the rest of the site.
This issue started around New Year's Eve and heavily contributed to the site-wide decline.
answer.next_step: Investigate the home page release deployed around December 31 to check for broken product links or rendering issues.
